name: @samvardiq/application-services
description: Protected application request boundary (IDENTITY-W4): framework-neutral authentication/authorization boundary composing identity-access's TrustedOrganizationContext with data-foundation's organization-scoped repositories. No HTTP framework — request boundary contracts only, ready to be wired into a router once one is chosen (a separate, explicit decision, not made here).

scripts.build:deps: npm run build --prefix ../marketing-intelligence && npm run build --prefix ../approval-governance && npm run build --prefix ../data-foundation && npm run build --prefix ../identity-access
